{{Quote|Platt Okeefe was wondering if spacers out the Lan Barell way might drop in on the Chyakk clan (the Wookiees, not the Bentora Space people) at the Shullel spaceport and tell them she's found the parts they wanted already.|A news report by [[Cynabar's InfoNet/Legends|Cynabar's InfoNet]]|<ref name="GNN" />}}
The '''Chyakk clan''' was a clan of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. They were based in the [[Shulell City]] [[Shulell City spaceport|spaceport]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] once found some parts which she planned to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] to the clan.<ref name="GNN" />
